commits.body:

Qualifying the actual second-JAR caller for Log4j allowed the frozen composer to decide the remaining two, for 63 registered histories across 11 PRs. Six of eight checked sides hit the warm cache and matched clean execution. Log4j used 128 checked field updates in its cold comparison, bound 192 live calendar choices, and reused three of four sides. Both projects rejected stale evidence after a same-path replacement and reproduced every outcome independently.

Rechecked all 11 original matrices, the three new supplemental archives, 72 earlier omission controls, all 70 outputs from 36 collector records, 556 internal references in 102 plans, and 103 campaign-report links. All 59 affected Rust binaries and 12 Python tests passed, including a successful retry of a process-timing test. Six of this cycle’s seven verification jobs passed.
